target.title: fix(init): select authenticated X account
target.body:
Fresh BirdClaw databases currently keep the demo `@steipete` identity even when xurl is authenticated as someone else. That sends the first sync toward the wrong account unless the database is repaired manually.

This change makes `birdclaw init` adopt the authenticated xurl identity and adds `--account <username>` for users with multiple OAuth2 accounts. It persists the selected handle and X user ID, while only replacing the untouched demo seed so imported archive ownership remains safe.

## Test plan

- `pnpm test` — 1,276 tests passed
- `pnpm check` — formatting, lint, and TypeScript passed
- Added regression coverage for explicit OAuth2 selection, external user ID persistence, CLI option forwarding, and preservation of imported accounts

## Post-Deploy Monitoring & Validation

No deployment-specific monitoring is needed. Validate with a fresh database by running `birdclaw init --account <username>` and confirming the returned account matches the selected authenticated xurl identity.
